summary: Added the unset-by-default platforms list with ordered storage, canonical mixed-team formatting, and shared-only source enforcement for platforms and mixed-team shell overrides. Updated the configuration guide and committed config/CLI regressions for the exact refusal paths.

notes: DistinctPlatforms, MixedPlatforms and FormatPlatforms provide one canonical linux, macos, windows view while preserving the caller's stored list order.
